scenarios.title: Two simultaneous transient NPCs and persistent miner
scenarios.steps: Run one saved ALIFE-08 startup mining fleet next to at least two stock transient NPCs with native cargo
scenarios.expected: Original transient cargo IDs remain cache-only and never appear on durable npcCargo.cargo SQLite row
evidence: original native SQLite npcCargo cargo root and receipt
transientPaths and in-memory cache
original native ship and cargoID identity
cold-restart and two-player logs where applicable
